# Open-Source and Model Licenses

_Longstead by Core Hermit. Effective October 9, 2026_

Longstead includes or can download third-party software, data, a font, and AI models. This file lists them, with the license texts the authors require us to reproduce. The licenses below apply to those components only. They do not change the terms that apply to Longstead itself (see the Terms of Use, and for the Mac download the Software License Agreement).

The Swift packages below are the open-source libraries built into the app. Some, such as swift-syntax, are used only while the app is built.

## Contents
1. Swift package dependencies
2. Bundled font
3. Tax data sources
4. Optional downloadable AI models
5. Apple technologies

## 3. Tax data sources

The tax tables bundled in the app (federal brackets, standard deductions and capital-gains thresholds for 2024 to 2026; state income tax data for 2025 for nine states; the Required Minimum Distribution divisor table) are **compiled by the developer from public sources**, mainly Internal Revenue Service publications and revenue procedures, the Social Security Administration, and the published rate schedules of state revenue departments. Tax figures are facts published by government bodies; the compilation, formatting, and any errors are ours. The data may be out of date, incomplete, or wrong, and tax law changes. It is not an official source and is not endorsed by the IRS, the SSA, or any state. Always confirm figures with the issuing agency or a qualified tax professional. If you enter your own tax-data feed address in Settings, the app can download newer versions of the same files from it (see the Privacy Policy).
